verified.channel: Previously observed HTTPS official /download card first Lite link exactly matches hyphen URL and version label 36.9.61; distinct underscore variant cannot satisfy current card gate. This peer did not make network requests.
verified.head: Previously observed exact hyphen URL HEAD HTTP200/TLS0/no redirects, Content-Length 48413684 and APK MIME; runtime reruns page and HEAD before GET.
verified.bounds: Runtime page curl max-time25/max-filesize600000 and post-size; HEAD max-time20; exact URL GET max-time180/max-filesize48413684/retry0/no follow or resume and exact received byte count; subprocess 30/25/190 seconds.
verified.one_shot: O_EXCL durable START precedes network; new staging required; terminal RESULT hard-link no-replace, failure/unknown is not replayable.
verified.postchecks: ZIP CRC and one manifest, package, min/target SDK presence, arm64-v8a-only or no native libs, one signer v2/v3 and observed certificate SHA, tool/APK postguards. Candidate flags keep raw/blackbox/startup uncredited.

blocking_flaw.title: Downloaded Manifest version is not checked against frozen card identity
blocking_flaw.evidence: PREPARE states exact package/version. run.py official_lite_card requires page version 36.9.61, but post-download checks only regex versionCode=digits and versionName=any nonempty; mock same package with versionCode 999999/versionName 99.99.99 satisfies those predicates.
blocking_flaw.impact: A different APK of the same package, size and ABI could be labeled OFFICIAL_CHANNEL_RAW_CANDIDATE_STATIC_PASS despite violating frozen version and 360961 filename/card. One-shot download would be consumed before this defect is discovered; fix gate first.

minimum_v2_fix: After aapt2 parse, require version_code == 360961 and version_name == 36.9.61, with explicit negative local fixture for wrong code and wrong name.
Freeze new runner/fixture/PREPARE SHA in a fresh v2 leaf, verify no START/RESULT/staging there, and independently re-review before one bounded GET.
nonblocking_limits: Package and ABI of hyphen artifact are unknowable until GET; G287 underscore variant was com.tiktok.lite.go and armeabi-v7a, so do not extrapolate.
No publisher artifact SHA or independent certificate anchor; even a v2 postcheck pass proves observed channel/candidate only, not publisher byte identity or blackbox qualification.
HEAD header dump has no explicit script file-size cap; transport timeouts and curl header parser limit duration, but this should be noted.
